sentences.text: Shri Vishal Singh Panwar - G.A. appearing on behalf o  General.
Shri Ayushi Thakur - appeared for respondent/objector  ORDER 1] Heard finally with the consent of the parties.

2] This petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of Cr.P.C./Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashment of FIR/charge sheet dated 12/09/2023 bearing Crime No.52/2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC registered at Police Station Crime Branch,
Indore District Indore and other consequential proceedings.
3] Counsel for the petitioner and respondent No.2, at the outset have submitted that the parties have already settled the matter out of the Court.
It is submitted that no purpose would be served by keeping the matter pending, the result of which is already decided.

It is further submitted that the factum 2 MCRC-55222-2024 of compromise has also been verified by the Principal Registrar of this Court on 10/02/2025, whose report is also filed on record, wherein it is also observed that the complainant has not entered into a compromise with all the accused persons named in the FIR but only with the present petitioner and one other petition M.Cr.C. No.29200/2024 (Divyansh vs. State of M.P. and others) has already been allowed quashing the FIR against the co-accused Divyansh,
and in such circumstances, the petition may be allowed.
